scope: Real desktop UI, Studio, LyricPrefetcher, LyricsLibrary and Electron IPC; declared synthetic remote catalogue/provider/lyrics
assertions: Each current/upcoming song was requested once
A ready cached transition sends no redundant lyric IPC
Unknown/jitter metadata causes no provider request
An empty final response retains useful prefetched lines
Partial promotion shares its original provider request
A settled cached lyric is not reported missing
Explicit failed refresh retains known lyrics
Explicit refresh issues exactly one deliberate request
UI tone/tempo controls enable only transport
The full UI has no uncaught script errors
